summary.text: Kaylee Tuck is a Republican member of the Florida House of Representatives for District 83.

paragraphs.text: According to the House's biographical page, Tuck was first elected in 2020 and lives in Lake Placid.
Tuck is a real estate and land use attorney with a B.S. in economics from Florida State University and a J.D. from Stetson University College of Law.
